//: Synthetic example of config/nodes.json - the node -> role map the
//2: tatbot CLI uses for role gating and --on <node> ssh hops.
//3: Addresses use RFC 5737 documentation ranges; replace every value
//4: with your own deployment. Fields per node: ssh (user@address,
//5: required for --on), roles (list, gates which verbs run here),
//7: differs from the node name), checkout (optional remote repo path).
//7b: Every role the code resolves is held by some node here (the Rust
//7c: workspace compiles this map in), split as a two-host rig: the
//7d: workstation plans, serves and conducts, the robot host owns the arm
//8: The reference rig runs 7 cameras: 5 PoE IP cameras (__cameras__ below)
//9: plus 2 USB RealSense D405 depth cameras attached to the node holding
//10: the 'realsense' role - USB devices are addressed by serial in the
//12: __rig__ names the rig's own subnet and gateway: cameras, arm
//13: controllers and every ssh_lan/lan address live in it, and
//14: `tatbot check nodes` holds the vision config, driver profile and
//15: controller YAMLs to it, so renumbering the rig is one edit here.
